continuity_scope: Dungeons & Dragons Fifth Edition setting witness: Van Richten's Guide to Ravenloft, official D&D Beyond source page published 17 May 2021. This is the 5e campaign-sourcebook continuity only, not Curse of Strahd, earlier editions, novels, games, actual plays, or adaptations.

work_or_witnesses.edition: Official D&D Beyond Fifth Edition source page, published 17 May 2021.
Official D&D Beyond marketplace product; Wizards of the Coast publisher/product scope.
Official D&D Beyond staff release/support notice; 5e product framing and character-option implementation.

coverage_rule: Terms-only audit. The accessible official source page shows sourcebook structure, domains, horror tools, and indexed names but not enough licensed claim-level prose to profile a named darklord/NPC. No character or relationship records are made from index placement alone. Domains, lineages, classes, monsters, curses, items, places, and horror rules remain terms/dimensions, never nodes.
omissions: All named darklords and NPCs indexed by the product, including Strahd von Zarovich, because a source-page heading is not a claim-level profile.
Curse of Strahd, all pre-5e Ravenloft editions, novels, games, actual plays, and screen/audio/comic adaptations as separate witnesses.
Table-created player characters, generic lineages/classes, monsters, domains, curses, artifacts, and core-D&D rules as character records.
Any statement about personal consent processes beyond the book's visible horror-preparation/running/after-horror headings; tables need their own safety agreements.
uncertainties: The source page is an official contents/index witness, not a full licensed text. It supports term and product-boundary claims only.
No distinct official errata record for this product was used in this pass; later printing, D&D Beyond, and rules-update changes require their own dated witness rather than being silently harmonized.
The product's horror categories and themes can implicate abuse, coercion, body horror, trauma, discrimination, and violence. This catalog is non-graphic and does not prescribe player comfort levels.
evidence_basis: Official D&D Beyond pages identify the 2021 5e campaign sourcebook, its Domains of Dread/Mists/Darklord/horror structure, and product scope. The staff notice describes it as a guide for Domains of Dread and horror adventures. No wiki, fan work, or adaptation material is used.
